measures.title: San Rafael Essential Services Protection Measure
measures.summary: Raises the City of San Rafael's real property transfer tax, paid only when real property is sold, from 0.2% to 1%. The ballot question says it would raise about $7.5 million a year until ended by voters for city services such as fire protection, paramedics, 9-1-1 response, street repair, and addressing homelessness, litter and illegal dumping, with annual audits and public spending disclosure.
measures.yesMeans: San Rafael's real property transfer tax rises from 0.2% to 1% of the sale price.
